title: Canonical surface point-blowup fibre data and finite strict-transform chains
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative local ring, $S=\operatorname{Spec}R$, and $s$ its closed point [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. For a morphism $f:X\to S$ of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and a closed point $p\in X$, put $J_p=\mathcal I(\{p\})$, the vanishing ideal of the reduced point [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], and $q_p:\operatorname{Bl}_{J_p}(X)\to X$ [def-nagata-global-blowup]. Define its family morphism to be $q_p f$ and its exceptional scheme to be the scheme-theoretic fibre $q_p^{-1}(p)$ with its canonical immersion and projection to $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(p)$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre], [def-weil-residue-field]. For $a\in R$ let $a_x$ be its canonical image in $\mathcal O_{X,x}$; exact maximal-ideal order $d$ means $a_x\in\mathfrak m_x^d\setminus\mathfrak m_x^{d+1}$. Define the local divisor coefficient at $x$ to be $\operatorname{length}_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}(\mathcal O_{X,x}/(a_x))\in\mathbf N\cup\{\infty\}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-length]. For $f(p)=s$ retain the canonical map $\kappa(s)\to\kappa(p)$ and the exceptional curve's induced morphism to $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$; for a scheme over a field retain the canonical field-to-point-residue-field map [def-weil-residue-field]. A reduced special-fibre component is an integral [def-pc-integral-scheme] closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] $i:C\to X$ whose image is the image in $X$ of an irreducible component of $X_s$ [def-weil-irreducible-components], [def-pc-scheme-fibre]. Define the finite point-blowup transform-chain relation on $(f:X\to S,i:C\to X)$ and $(g:Y\to S,j:D\to Y,r:D\to C)$ inductively: zero steps means $(g,j,r)=(f,i,\mathrm{id})$; a successor blows up a reduced closed point $y\in Y_s$, replaces $g$ by $q_y g$, replaces $j$ by its scheme-theoretic strict transform, and composes its canonical map to $D$ with $r$ [def-nagata-strict-transform]. Finally, for a subset $Z\subset X$, define nodal geometric fibres near $Z$ to mean that an open neighbourhood $U$ of $Z$ has flat locally finitely presented structure morphism [def-weil-flat-morphism], [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], and every algebraically closed geometric fibre over $U$ is reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme] of pure dimension one [def-weil-geometric-fibre], [def-weil-pure-dimension], with every nonsmooth closed point [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] an ordinary double point in the existing completed-local-ring sense [def-trf-projective-nodal-tower]. Empty and disconnected geometric fibres are allowed.
